topic: The real-life case of a man living a normal, functional life despite having only a fraction of his brain, challenging scientific understanding of consciousness and plasticity.
title: He Lived With Almost NO Brain 🤯🧠
script: Imagine a man with an IQ of 75, a job, a family... But doctors scanning his head found his skull was almost entirely filled with fluid! His brain tissue was barely there. How was he even alive? This incredible case shattered everything scientists thought they knew about the brain and consciousness. It's the ultimate proof of neuroplasticity... or something much stranger.
